verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a hosted AI creative platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents generation features, pricing, MCP/CLI and a REST API, but nothing about exporting all account data in open formats or about account closure. The API is at most a developer building block for retrieving generations, not a documented full-data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
